Test sceario: Verify that the “Put Address Here to Order” feature validates the entered Zip Code format.
Test steps: Click on the “Put Address Here to Order” field. Enter an invalid Zip Code, such as "no number code". Attempt to proceed with the order.
Expected result: The system should validate the Zip Code format and display an error message (e.g., “Please enter a valid Zip Code.”). The order should not proceed until a valid numeric Zip Code is entered.
Actual Result: The system accepts invalid Zip Codes like "no number code". The user is able to proceed without proper validation.

Test sceario: Verify that changing the “Items Per Page” setting to 3 limits the displayed products to three per page.
Test steps: Locate the “Items Per Page” option on the product listing page. Set the value to 3. Observe the number of products displayed on the page.
Expected result: Only three products are displayed on the current page. Pagination (Next/Previous buttons) adjusts accordingly if more products exist. No layout or display issues occur.
Actual Result: Only three products are displayed on the current page. Pagination (Next/Previous buttons) adjusts accordingly if more products exist. No layout or display issues occur.

Test sceario: Check that changing the product display layout from horizontal to vertical updates the page layout correctly.
Test steps: Locate the Display Options section on the product listing page.     Select the Vertical display option instead of the current Horizontal view.    Observe how the products are displayed.
Expected result: The product layout successfully changes from Horizontal to Vertical. All product details (image, title, price, etc.) are properly aligned in vertical format. No distortion or alignment issues appear on the page.
Actual Result: The product layout successfully changes from Horizontal to Vertical. All product details (image, title, price, etc.) are properly aligned in vertical format. No distortion or alignment issues appear on the page.
